title: When the Orchard Burns
author: Marguerite Pemberton
blurb: Paloma Voss, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
